findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test. The drifting app-theme cases still use the branch that also changes a screen. The new independent branch tests a copy-only drift, then restores the copy and changes the CSS without introducing drift. A regression that checks screen or copy changes but skips a drifting app-theme-only change would therefore pass this proof. The branch setup is in tests/test_close.py:216.
Case: normal use - A worker changes only apps/web/src/index.css to a value that differs from the approved copy. Add a refusal assertion for that change without a screen or copy change.
